# FormField

A labeled form field that adds a required marker, prefix/suffix decorators, character counter, static description, and validation hints around any input control passed as `children`.

```ts
import { FormField } from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

## Basic Usage

A complete activity-creation form composed from `FormField` wrappers around every control type WFM ships: text `Input`, `Dropdown`, `DatePicker` + `TimeSelectInput` paired in a single field, a single `Choice` checkbox, a 2-column grid of multi-select `Choice` checkboxes, a horizontal radio group, and a `Textarea` — closed off by a primary/secondary `Button` row. Each row keeps the standard vertical layout: label on top (with the red `*` for required fields) and helper / hint text below the control.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Button,
  Choice,
  DatePicker,
  Dropdown,
  FormField,
  Input,
  TimeSelectInput,
  Textarea,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

const zoneOptions = [
  { label: 'Asia / Shanghai', value: 'asia-shanghai' },
  { label: 'Europe / Lisbon', value: 'europe-lisbon' },
  { label: 'America / New York', value: 'america-ny' },
];

const activityTypes = [
  { label: 'Online activities', value: 'online' },
  { label: 'Promotion activities', value: 'promotion' },
  { label: 'Offline activities', value: 'offline' },
  { label: 'Simple brand exposure', value: 'brand' },
];

export default function Demo() {
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [zone, setZone] = useState(null);
  const [date, setDate] = useState(null);
  const [time, setTime] = useState('');
  const [instant, setInstant] = useState(false);
  const [types, setTypes] = useState([]);
  const [resource, setResource] = useState('sponsor');
  const [form, setForm] = useState('');

  const toggleType = (value) => {
    setTypes((prev) =>
      prev.includes(value) ? prev.filter((v) => v !== value) : [...prev, value]
    );
  };

  return (
    <Box padding="4" width="640px">
      <Flex direction="column" gap="4">
        <FormField isRequired htmlFor="activity-name" label="Activity name">
          <Input
            id="activity-name"
            value={name}
            placeholder="Enter activity name"
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
            data-qa="activity-name"
          />
        </FormField>

        <FormField isRequired label="Activity zone">
          <Dropdown
            value={zone}
            options={zoneOptions}
            onChange={(v) => setZone(v)}
            messages={{ placeholder: 'Please select your zone' }}
            data-qa="activity-zone"
          />
        </FormField>

        <FormField isRequired label="Activity time">
          <Flex alignY="center" gap="2" width="100%">
            <Box grow>
              <DatePicker
                isFullWidth
                size="medium"
                value={date}
                onChange={setDate}
                placeholder="Pick a date"
                data-qa="activity-date"
              />
            </Box>
            <Box>—</Box>
            <Box grow>
              <TimeSelectInput
                value={time}
                size="medium"
                onChange={setTime}
                placeholder="Pick a time"
                data-qa="activity-time"
              />
            </Box>
          </Flex>
        </FormField>

        <FormField label="Instant delivery">
          <Choice
            checked={instant}
            onChange={setInstant}
            label="Deliver immediately after creation"
            data-qa="instant-delivery"
          />
        </FormField>

        <FormField label="Activity type">
          <Box
            style={{
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr',
              rowGap: 8,
              columnGap: 24,
            }}
          >
            {activityTypes.map((opt) => (
              <Choice
                key={opt.value}
                checked={types.includes(opt.value)}
                onChange={() => toggleType(opt.value)}
                label={opt.label}
                data-qa={`activity-type-${opt.value}`}
              />
            ))}
          </Box>
        </FormField>

        <FormField label="Resources">
          <Flex gap="6">
            {['sponsor', 'venue'].map((value) => (
              <Choice
                key={value}
                type="radio"
                name="activity-resource"
                value={value}
                checked={resource === value}
                onChange={() => setResource(value)}
                label={value === 'sponsor' ? 'Sponsor' : 'Venue'}
                data-qa={`resource-${value}`}
              />
            ))}
          </Flex>
        </FormField>

        <FormField
          label="Activity form"
          currentInput={form.length}
          maxInput={200}
        >
          <Textarea
            value={form}
            placeholder="Describe the activity"
            rows={4}
            maxLength={200}
            onChange={(e) => setForm(e.target.value)}
            data-qa="activity-form"
          />
        </FormField>

        <Flex gap="2">
          <Button data-qa="create" type="primary" onClick={() => null}>
            Create
          </Button>
          <Button data-qa="cancel" type="secondary" onClick={() => null}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
        </Flex>
      </Flex>
    </Box>
  );
}
```

## Required

Set `isRequired` to render a red asterisk next to the label.

```tsx preview
import { FormField } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Input from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-input';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Box width="320px" padding="4">
      <FormField
        isRequired
        htmlFor="queue-name"
        label="Queue Name"
        description="Enter a unique name for this queue"
      >
        <Input
          id="queue-name"
          placeholder="e.g. Support Team A"
          size="medium"
          style={{ width: '100%', padding: '0 8px' }}
        />
      </FormField>
    </Box>
  );
}
```

## Prefix and Suffix

Use `prefix` to prepend a fixed label or icon, and `suffix` to append one. Both accept a string or any React node. The prefix/suffix cells use the `InputGroup.Item` component internally and share the same border as the input.

- `prefix="$"` — renders a currency symbol on the left
- `suffix=".com"` — renders a domain on the right

```tsx preview
import { FormField } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Input from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-input';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" gap="6" padding="4" width="320px">
      <FormField
        htmlFor="salary"
        label="Monthly Salary"
        prefix="$"
        description="Enter gross monthly salary in USD"
      >
        <Input
          id="salary"
          placeholder="5000"
          size="medium"
          type="number"
          variation="unstyled"
          style={{ width: '100%', padding: '0 8px' }}
        />
      </FormField>

      <FormField
        htmlFor="website"
        label="Website"
        suffix=".com"
        description="Enter your subdomain"
      >
        <Input
          id="website"
          placeholder="my-company"
          size="medium"
          variation="unstyled"
          style={{ width: '100%', padding: '0 8px' }}
        />
      </FormField>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Validation States

Use `variation` to apply error or warning styling. The border and label colour change to reflect the state. Use `errorHint` or `warningHint` (not `description`) for validation feedback — they are only rendered when the matching `variation` is active, and automatically gain a leading icon and the corresponding colour.

`description` and a hint prop can coexist: `description` remains in neutral grey at all times, while the hint appears beneath it only when validation is triggered.

- `variation="error"` + `errorHint` — red border, red label, `error_outline` icon, red hint text
- `variation="warning"` + `warningHint` — amber border, amber label, `warning` icon, amber hint text

```tsx preview
import { FormField } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Input from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-input';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" gap="6" padding="4" width="320px">
      <FormField
        isRequired
        htmlFor="email-error"
        label="Email Address"
        variation="error"
        description="We will send your confirmation here"
        errorHint="Please enter a valid email address"
      >
        <Input
          id="email-error"
          value="not-an-email"
          size="medium"
          style={{ width: '100%', padding: '0 8px' }}
          onChange={() => {}}
        />
      </FormField>

      <FormField
        htmlFor="password-warning"
        label="Password"
        variation="warning"
        warningHint="Password is weak — consider adding numbers and symbols"
      >
        <Input
          id="password-warning"
          type="password"
          value="abc123"
          size="medium"
          style={{ width: '100%', padding: '0 8px' }}
          onChange={() => {}}
        />
      </FormField>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Character Counter

Pass `currentInput` and `maxInput` together to show a counter tag in the top-right corner of the label row. The tag turns red when `currentInput` exceeds `maxInput`.

- Normal: neutral grey tag showing `current/max`
- Over limit: red tag, matching `variation="error"` colours

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { FormField } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Input from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-input';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

const MAX = 50;

export default function Demo() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState('Hello, World!');

  const isOver = value.length > MAX;

  return (
    <Flex direction="column" gap="6" padding="4" width="360px">
      <FormField
        htmlFor="short-desc"
        label="Short Description"
        currentInput={value.length}
        maxInput={MAX}
        variation={isOver ? 'error' : undefined}
        description="Keep it brief"
        errorHint={isOver ? `Exceeds ${MAX} characters` : undefined}
      >
        <Input
          id="short-desc"
          value={value}
          size="medium"
          style={{ width: '100%', padding: '0 8px' }}
          onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
        />
      </FormField>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop             | Type                   | Default          | Description                                                                      |
| ---------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`          | `string`               | —                | Label text rendered above the input group                                        |
| `htmlFor`        | `string`               | —                | Links the label to the inner input via `id`                                      |
| `children`       | `ReactNode`            | —                | Input control(s) rendered inside the `InputGroup`                                |
| `isRequired`     | `boolean`              | `false`          | Shows a required asterisk next to the label                                      |
| `variation`      | `'error' \| 'warning'` | —                | Validation state — applies coloured borders and label                            |
| `description`    | `string`               | —                | Static helper text always shown below the input in neutral grey. No icon.        |
| `errorHint`      | `string`               | —                | Error message with `error_outline` icon. Only rendered when `variation="error"`. |
| `warningHint`    | `string`               | —                | Warning message with `warning` icon. Only rendered when `variation="warning"`.   |
| `prefix`         | `ReactNode`            | —                | Content prepended to the left of the input (string or node)                      |
| `suffix`         | `ReactNode`            | —                | Content appended to the right of the input (string or node)                      |
| `currentInput`   | `number`               | —                | Current character count — requires `maxInput` to show counter                    |
| `maxInput`       | `number`               | —                | Maximum character count — requires `currentInput`                                |
| `size`           | `'small' \| 'medium'`  | `'medium'`       | Input group size                                                                 |
| `data-qa`        | `string`               | —                | QA selector prefix                                                               |
| `data-component` | `string`               | `'WFMFormField'` | Component identifier                                                             |
